headline: Google offers students 1 year of AI Pro for free, includes 5TB storage
summary: Eligible college students in the US can claim a year of Google's AI Pro subscription, normally $200, at no cost. The offer also includes a massive 5TB of cloud storage.
details: Google is providing eligible college students in the US with a full year of its AI Pro subscription for free. This premium service typically costs $200 annually or $20 per month. The promotion aims to increase engagement with Gemini.

Subscribers gain quadruple usage limits within Gemini, access to the Spark agentic platform, and Gemini integration across Workspace apps like Gmail and Docs. Beyond AI features, the offer includes a substantial 5TB of cloud storage.

The promotion also bundles a subscription to Google Health Premium, which syncs with Fitbit and other health trackers. For students outside the US, Google offers a year of Google AI Plus for free, providing access to Gemini Omni and 400GB of storage.

Google is also offering a discounted bundle that combines AI Pro and YouTube Premium for $9 per month. However, users should be aware that the AI Pro subscription auto-renews at the full price, so setting a cancellation reminder is advised.
